subject: science
cluster: Stars, the Sun, and patterns in the sky
skillName: Why the Sun Looks Brighter Than Other Stars

items.prompt:
The Sun is
A) not a star
B) a star
C) a planet
D) a moon

steps: The Sun is a star, a glowing ball of hot gas.

items.prompt:
The Sun looks brighter than other stars because it is
A) much closer to Earth
B) made of different stuff
C) the only star
D) colder

steps: Being much closer makes the Sun look far brighter.

items.prompt:
Of two identical flashlights, the one that looks brighter is the one that is
A) farther away
B) closer
C) turned off
D) bigger

steps: A closer light looks brighter when both give off the same light.

items.prompt:
The main reason other stars look dim is that they are
A) very far away
B) not giving off light
C) small rocks
D) behind the Moon

steps: Great distance makes bright stars look dim.

items.prompt:
If the Sun were as far away as other stars, it would look like
A) a huge bright disk
B) a tiny dim point
C) the Moon
D) a planet

steps: At that distance the Sun would appear faint like other stars.

items.prompt:
A faraway star looks dim. This means
A) it gives off little light for sure
B) it may give off lots of light but is very far
C) it is close
D) it is a planet
items.answer: B) it may give off lots of light but is very far

steps: Dimness can be caused by distance, not low light output.

items.prompt:
Two stars give off the same amount of light, but star X looks brighter than star Y. The best conclusion is
A) star X is closer to Earth
B) star Y is closer
C) they are the same distance
D) star X is a planet
items.answer: A) star X is closer to Earth

steps: With equal light output, the brighter-looking star is closer.

items.prompt:
Which is the best-supported argument?
A) The Sun is the brightest because it is the biggest star
B) The Sun looks brightest mainly because it is the closest star to Earth
C) Other stars give off no light
D) The Sun is not a star
items.answer: B) The Sun looks brightest mainly because it is the closest star to Earth

steps: Distance, not size, best explains the Sun's apparent brightness.
